title: Debian Observability And Active Security Roadmap
goal: Build a small, Podman-aware observability and security backbone for the Debian Odysseus server so performance, health, logs, security decisions and Odysseus runtime failures become inspectable and alertable.

context.target_host: Debian server running Odysseus with Podman pods
context.operator_need: Odysseus should be diagnosable from server evidence when Telegram, reminders, workers, memory, RaptorGraph, Nextcloud import, local models or deploy tasks fail.
context.important_correction: Do not design this around Docker. The runtime strategy is Podman pods.
context.promtail_note: Do not introduce Promtail as a new component. Promtail is EOL as of 2026-03-02 according to Grafana documentation; prefer Grafana Alloy, Fluent Bit or OpenTelemetry Collector for new log shipping.

metrics.odysseus: Odysseus app/runtime metrics endpoint or exporter -> Prometheus

logs.agent: Grafana Alloy preferred; Fluent Bit or OpenTelemetry Collector acceptable fallback

scope: Odysseus HTTP/API access logs where available
security.dashboards: CrowdSec decisions, alerts, parsed lines, scenario overflows and bans in Grafana

slice_queue.goal: Inventory the Debian server runtime layout, Podman pods, systemd services, current log paths, ports and existing health endpoints without changing live services.
allowed_actions: read-only SSH/systemd/podman status commands after operator Go
no install, restart, port exposure or config mutation
slice_queue.done_when: A redacted inventory lists services, pod names, log sources, candidate scrape endpoints and privacy-sensitive log classes.
slice_queue.evidence: Created docs/plans/debian-observability-security-inventory.json as a repo-only redacted inventory contract. It lists known user systemd units, expected Podman target groups, candidate log sources, scrape endpoints, privacy-sensitive log classes and a read-only live inventory plan. The inventory is marked live_observed=false; server confirmation remains gated by debian-observability-live-go.

slice_queue.goal: Install or enable Node Exporter and scrape host metrics with Prometheus.
slice_queue.done_when: Prometheus scrapes host CPU, memory, disk, filesystem, load and network metrics; Grafana has a host overview dashboard.
acceptance: node exporter endpoint is not publicly exposed
disk usage, memory pressure and service-down alert candidates are visible
no secrets or private content are exported as labels

slice_queue.goal: Add Podman/pod/container visibility without assuming Docker.
components: cAdvisor only if compatible with this Podman/cgroups setup
slice_queue.done_when: Grafana shows Odysseus pod/container CPU, memory, restart and health signals.
acceptance: Docker socket is not required
Odysseus, Chroma, SearXNG, Nextcloud-related and model worker pods are distinguishable
resource spikes from local model maintenance can be correlated with Odysseus events

slice_queue.goal: Ship redacted operational logs to Loki using Grafana Alloy or an approved fallback.
slice_queue.done_when: Grafana Explore can query Odysseus, Telegram, scheduler, inbox, memory, RaptorGraph, Nextcloud import and Podman/systemd logs with useful labels.
acceptance: Promtail is not newly deployed
retention is configured before broad ingestion
private document content, tokens, chat IDs and host-private raw paths are not shipped as log payloads or labels
label cardinality is bounded

slice_queue.goal: Expose Odysseus-specific health and runtime counters suitable for Prometheus scraping.
slice_queue.done_when: Odysseus exposes a redacted metrics endpoint or exporter that Prometheus can scrape without private data leakage.
acceptance: metrics are owner-safe and content-free
high-cardinality labels are rejected
existing ai_activity_ledger and app logs remain the forensic source for detailed redacted events

slice_queue.goal: Add CrowdSec for active security monitoring and optional remediation, starting with observe-only behavior.
components: crowdsec collections for ssh and web/reverse-proxy logs
slice_queue.done_when: CrowdSec parses approved logs, exposes metrics, and Grafana shows alerts/decisions without unintended blocking.
acceptance: first phase is detect/observe-only unless operator explicitly approves remediation
bouncer/remediation is a separate gate
false-positive handling is documented

slice_queue.goal: Define alert rules and route important incidents to the operator without alert fatigue.
slice_queue.done_when: Alert rules and notification routing policy are documented and ready for live enablement.
acceptance: alerts have severity levels
Telegram notifications are gated and do not leak secrets
maintenance windows and local model heavy jobs can suppress noisy alerts

slice_queue.goal: Allow Odysseus to answer operational questions from bounded observability data instead of guessing.
example_questions: Warum kam heute um 9 keine Telegram To-Do Liste?
Warum wurde die Datei nicht importiert?
Ist Gemma E4B gerade zu langsam oder blockiert?
slice_queue.done_when: Odysseus can assemble a redacted diagnostic packet from metrics/log summaries and cite which subsystem caused the failure.
acceptance: no raw private logs are sent to external models in DSGVO mode
diagnostic packets are redacted and bounded
live Grafana/Loki/Prometheus queries are read-only

gate_queue.decision_needed: Approve bounded read-only server inventory first; approve installs/config changes separately per component.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Metrics/log/security components could expose private data, open ports or change security behavior unexpectedly.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Decide whether Grafana stays localhost/VPN/private only or is exposed through a protected tunnel.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Dashboards can reveal operational metadata and service topology.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Approve whether CrowdSec may actively block IPs after observe-only validation.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: False positives could block legitimate operator access.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Set retention duration and sensitive log redaction policy before ingestion.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Private or high-volume logs may be retained longer than intended.

non_goals: Do not introduce Docker as the operational default.
Do not deploy Promtail as a new logging agent.
Do not expose Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, exporters or CrowdSec endpoints publicly without explicit operator design and access control.
Do not persist Telegram chat IDs, API tokens, private document contents or raw user data in dashboards, metrics labels or handoff docs.
Do not turn on CrowdSec remediation before observe-only evidence is reviewed.
definition_of_done: Host metrics, Podman/runtime metrics, Odysseus health metrics and CrowdSec metrics are visible in Grafana.
Operational logs flow into Loki through a supported log agent with bounded labels and retention.
Critical alerts exist for Telegram, scheduler, disk, memory, RaptorGraph, Nextcloud import and service-down failures.
Odysseus can use read-only observability summaries for diagnostics without leaking private content.
All live installs and exposure decisions are documented as operator gates.

recommended_next_action.reason: OBS-0 safe-offline inventory is prepared and live confirmation is gated; the next safe slice is Odysseus runtime metrics contracts.
